mapper.select:
/*selectMSDSSubmitRequestList*/ SELECT 'I' AS SSTATUS ,ROWNUM AS NO ,TO_CHAR(REQ.REQ_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REQUEST_DATE ,REQ.REQ_NO AS REQUEST_NO ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'CM01_V2' AND COD.CODE = REQ.REQ_STATUS) AS STATUS , '/resources/imgs/Btn_RegIng.gif' AS BTN01 ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = REQ.BUYER) AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_CODE ,DECODE(D.DESCRIPTION, NULL, B.DESCRIPTION_LOC, D.DESCRIPTION) AS ITEM_NAME ,DECODE(D.SPECIFICATION, NULL, B.SPECIFICATION, D.SPECIFICATION) AS SPEC ,DECODE(D.MAKER_NAME, NULL, B.MAKER_NAME, D.MAKER_NAME) AS MANUFACTURER
,CASE WHEN REQ.QUOTATION_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '견적 단계' ELSE '발주 단계' END AS GUBUN
,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.BUYER = REQ.BUYER AND MNG.KEP_USER_ID = USR.USER_ID AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' AND MNG.PRIORITY ='Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS KEP_MANAGER
,(SELECT USR.PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR USR, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.BUYER = REQ.BUYER AND MNG.KEP_USER_ID = USR.USER_ID AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MNG.PRIORITY ='Y' AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS KEP_CONTACT
,TO_CHAR(REQ.STOA_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS SUBMIT_DATE ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = REQ.STOA_USER_ID) AS SUBMITTER ,TO_CHAR(REQ.CONFIRM_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS APPROVE_DATE ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = REQ.CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS APPROVER ,NVL((SELECT BYCA.CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA BYCA WHERE BYCA.COM_CODE = REQ.BUYER AND BYCA.STD_CATEG_ID = B.CMS_CATEG_ID AND ROWNUM = 1), '-') AS ICOMBYCA ,NVL((SELECT CMSC.CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG CMSC WHERE CMSC.CMS_CATEG_ID = B.CMS_CATEG_ID AND ROWNUM = 1), '-') AS CMSCATEG ,NVL(REQ.QUOTATION_NO, '') AS QUOTATION_NO ,NVL(REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ, '') AS QUOTATION_SEQ ,CASE WHEN REQ.REVISION IS NULL OR REQ.REVISION = 0 THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(REQ.REVISION) END AS REVISION ,NVL(REQ.BUYER, '') AS BUYER ,REQ.REQ_STATUS FROM KEP_CMC_REQ REQ, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMLUSR C, KEPRQDT D WHERE REQ.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND REQ.REQ_USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND B.STATUS(+) != 'D' AND REQ.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND REQ.QUOTATION_NO = D.QUOTATION_NO(+) AND REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ = D.QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND REQ.AGENT = #{sessionComCode}
AND TO_CHAR(REQ.STOA_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
AND TO_CHAR(REQ.CONFIRM_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
AND TO_CHAR(REQ.REQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
AND UPPER(REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{searchKeyword}||'%')
AND (B.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%'||#{searchKeyword}||'%' OR D.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{searchKeyword}||'%')
AND (B.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{searchKeyword}||'%' OR D.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{searchKeyword}||'%')
AND REQ.REQ_STATUS IN ('Q','R')
AND REQ.REQ_STATUS = 'Q'
AND REQ.REQ_STATUS = 'R'
AND REQ.REQ_STATUS IN ('Q','R')
AND REQ.REQ_STATUS IN ('Q','R')
AND REQ.REQ_STATUS NOT IN ('M', 'D', 'T', 'N')
AND REQ.QUOTATION_NO IS NOT NULL
AND REQ.QUOTATION_NO IS NULL
AND UPPER(REQ.REQ_NO) LIKE UPPER(#{requestNo}||'%')
AND UPPER(REQ.QUOTATION_NO) LIKE UPPER(#{quotationNo}||'%')
ORDER BY REQ.REQ_NO DESC
